title: Online task offer and deposit requests
rawChat:
[08/10/2026, 09:10] Nadia: Hi Raka, we offer tasks that involve liking posts, with a promised commission of IDR 50,000 per day.
[08/10/2026, 09:14] Nadia: To continue the tasks, please pay a deposit of IDR 180,000 to ****4821.
[08/10/2026, 09:28] Raka: I have just sent IDR 180,000. I have not recorded the transfer time yet.
[08/10/2026, 09:35] Nadia: Now add a deposit of IDR 420,000 so the balance can be withdrawn.
[08/10/2026, 09:40] Raka: The additional deposit is still pending. I have not seen the transaction on my bank statement.
